device_degraded.title: Somfy UAI+ not responding
device_degraded.description:
The Somfy UAI+ controller at **{host}** is not responding to status checks. The device may be in a degraded state and might need to be restarted.

Check **Settings → System → Logs** and filter for `somfy_uai_plus` for more details.
